scope: Exactly one integrated report content validation; no cross-request, tick, publication-phase or owner cache

isolatedPostgres.includes: New helper/wrapper, actual five-Agent ledgers and file delivery, legacy v2 and budget reports, native/mapped tamper checks, simulation

negativeCases: Each of five jobs independently rejects missing or rehashed tampered receipts
Revocation after computation prevents context-exit return
Cross-owner/report/binding and changed prepared input fail
Caller aliases cannot alter stored values
Loader exceptions and unknown outcomes are not cached
Closed, reentrant and cross-thread access fail
Exact 38000-byte analysis and 2MiB budget limits, 64-entry LRU and 4MiB charged capacity
verification.independentRootReview: Reviewed immutable snapshots, live binding checks before/after reuse and context exit, source-context completion, unchanged no-reuse path and preserved per-job proof validation

capacity.counts: Canonical completed JSON plus key and checksum bytes

limits: Recomputation counts are not a production latency or memory SLA
Claims continue their own exact reference verification
No persistent derived partitions or cross-request paging acceleration
